aggressive_definition_excerpt: There was heterogeneity in the association between docosapentaenoic acid and prostate cancer by grade of disease (P = .006); the association was statistically significant for low-grade disease but not high-grade disease.
grading_caveat: The abstract identifies “high-grade disease” but does not report the grade threshold or grading system used.
reason: The abstract analyzes total prostate cancer and explicitly reports an analysis of high-grade incident disease for docosapentaenoic acid.
